title: Best location in East Nash! 1.5 miles to downtown!
description:
Only 1.5 miles from downtown Nashville and the Titans stadium! Enjoy easy access to everything from this perfectly located home base. Walk out of the front door to find yourself in the middle of the Five Points/Fatherland District of East Nashville. Our small community features an array of 20+ local businesses, trendy restaurants, clothing, and so much more. With a fully equipped kitchen, cozy bedrooms, and lounge space in the living room you will feel right at home. Driveway parking available.

The space
Property has been renovated from head to toe! In our home you will find two bedrooms and two full bathrooms. It offers all of the modern amenities you need for a comfortable stay. Driveway space available for multiple vehicles.

Other things to note
Central to everything Nashville! You will find yourself only minutes from everything downtown.
